pay_detail: Unpaid. Students can earn community service credit. 50 hours a year earns a Volunteer ID card with free sanctuary admission.
duration: One day to weekly shifts; some positions are seasonal
name: Mass Audubon Volunteer Opportunities
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Mass Audubon wildlife sanctuary. Greet visitors, care for trails and gardens, help with programs, or log the wildlife you see.
who_can_apply: Volunteers are mostly 16 or older, unless a parent or guardian comes along. The minimum age changes by job. Some jobs need training or a background check (CORI or SORI).
deadline_text: No deadline. Positions are posted on the volunteer portal.
how_to_apply: Browse and respond to openings on the Mass Audubon Volunteer Portal. Large groups can use the group volunteer form.
notes: Busiest months are May to September. Younger teens can ask about parent-accompanied options.
